required_concepts: A rectangle does not always have all sides equal
A kite does not have opposite sides parallel
Rectangles do not necessarily have 4 equal sides
Rhombuses have two pairs of equal sides
optional_concepts: Angles in a rectangle are always 90 degrees
Kites have two pairs of adjacent sides that are equal
Parallelograms have opposite sides parallel and equal in length
acceptable_paraphrases: A square is not the same as a rectangle because they do not share all properties
Rectangles can vary in side lengths, unlike squares
Kites and rhombuses are distinct shapes with different properties
Not all rectangles are rhombuses due to differing side properties
critical_errors: Incorrectly stating that a rectangle has equal sides like a square
Saying that a rectangle is always a parallelogram or rhombus
Misstating the properties of a kite and confusing it with other shapes
misconceptions: Believing that all rectangles have four equal sides
Thinking that a rectangle is always a parallelogram or rhombus
Confusing the properties of a kite with those of other quadrilaterals
Stating that a rectangle can be both a square and a rhombus at the same time
grading_notes: Ensure all core concepts are covered. Accept alternative phrasings but ensure they convey the correct information. Avoid strict penalties for minor variations in wording.
